summary: Backend regression suite fully rewritten for the new JWT + email/password auth (Emergent OAuth removed). 29/29 tests pass covering register/login/me/logout/google, balance, deposit (card-field discard verified by scanning all Mongo collections), bets (win/lose/insufficient/negative), history ordering + no _id/user_id leaks, sports matches, and MongoDB indexes (email/user_id unique, google_sub sparse-unique, bets.user_id).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is well-structured (~380 lines, single file OK). Password hashed with bcrypt cost 12, JWT HS256 stateless with 7-day exp. Response sanitization via public_user() correctly strips _id and password_hash.
Email normalized to lowercase before insert/query — case-insensitive login confirmed by test.
Deposit endpoint intentionally ignores card_number/card_holder/expiry/cvv — verified by full-DB scan across every collection: zero leaks.
GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID unset → /api/auth/google returns 503 with clear PT message (correct). When configured, real google-auth library verifies id_token issuer/audience. Looks correct.
MongoDB indexes created on startup: users.email unique, users.user_id unique, users.google_sub sparse+unique, bets.user_id. Duplicate registration correctly caught via DuplicateKeyError → 409 PT.
Bets history returns sorted desc by created_at, excludes _id and user_id via projection, serializes datetime to ISO string.
Minor: /api/auth/logout is a no-op returning {ok:true} (correct for stateless JWT; client discards token). Could add token blocklist later but not needed for MVP.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (rewritten for JWT auth; removed obsolete /api/auth/session and user_sessions TTL tests)
seed_data_creation: Test users created via /api/auth/register with prefix TEST_simbet_<uuid8>@example.com and password SenhaSegura123. Autouse session fixture wipes all TEST_* users and TEST_* labelled bets before and after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend auth flow is JWT (HS256, 7 days). Endpoints: POST /api/auth/register|login|google|logout, GET /api/auth/me. user_sessions collection is deprecated. Testing user: TEST_simbet_<random>@example.com / SenhaSegura123. Google endpoint returns 503 unless GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID is set. To test Google end-to-end you'd need a real Google OAuth Web Client ID + a live id_token.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — no bugs found. Initial 3 test failures were assertion mistakes in the new test file (compared against raw TEST_EMAIL instead of its lowercased form). Backend's normalize_email() is correct security behavior; fixed the test to compare against .lower().
